def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def safe(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: safe(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(safe(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):

        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label

    try:

        new = run('new', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).splitlines()
        misplaced = 'R/research-phase4k-geometry-contract-round412-v1.txt'
        assert set(dirty + new) == set(build['source_pins']) | {misplaced}
        installed=Path('/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl/.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync/SKILL.md')
        assert installed.resolve()==G/'feat-strata-upstream-sync-skill-20261013/.claude/skills/strata-upstream-sync/SKILL.md'
        assert installed.is_file()
        assert not any(Path(path).exists() or Path(path).is_symlink() for path in
            ['/home/yayoi/.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync','/home/yayoi/.codex/skills/strata-upstream-sync'])
        r['skill_scope_checked']=dict(project_only=True,path=str(installed),resolved=str(installed.resolve()),sha256=m.sha(installed))
        F.mkdir()
        deletions = []
        for name, original in receipts.items():
            path = B / name / 'record.json'
            compact = {k: v for k, v in original.items() if k != 'evidence'}
            compact['original_receipt'] = dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                consumer='Active qualification-controller prerequisites; retire immutable original when downstream consumers use compact evidence')
            compact['retention_policy'] = 'Closed command text retired; full source/input/environment/individual results/faults and original failure findings retained.'

            target = F / 'receipts' / (name + '.json')

            assert load(target)['passed'] == original['passed']

                            replacement=str(target), replacement_sha256=m.sha(target), reason='Closed duplicate command text; ownership, status, findings and relevant actual evidence preserved'))
        report_names = ['research-phase-full-lease-safety-round405-v2.txt',

            'research-residual-transport-precision-round408-v1.txt', 'research-native-cpu-decode-kernels-round409-v1.txt',
            'research-phase-decode-capacity-profile-round410-v1.txt', 'research-layer-cache-bulk-copy-round411-v1.txt',
            'research-phase4k-geometry-contract-round412-v1.txt', 'research-phase4k-actual-pins-audit-round413-v1.txt',

            'research-decode-critical-path-profiler-round417-v1.txt', 'implementation-layer-major-phase4k-v1.txt',

            'implementation-serve-first-row-adapter-v1.txt', 'implementation-serve-first-row-adapter-v2.txt']
        reports = []

            dump(target, dict(original_path=str(path), original_sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text(),
                qualification='Source-only report. Main executed evidence is separate; R412 audited parent only, superseded for actual4K source by R413. R413 says five but explicitly lists six changed files.'))
            reports.append(dict(path=str(target.relative_to(F)), sha256=m.sha(target)))
            if path == W / misplaced:

        prior_path = L / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-restored-layer-major-lifecycle/report-registry-v195.json'

        registry = dict(research_completed=967 + len(reports), prior=dict(path=str(prior_path),
            git_revision='4951d2be7b674bb688832bf0b3cb750410f1a432', sha256=m.sha(prior_path)), new_reports=reports,
            main_only_test_execution=True, main_corrections='P failed4 fixture offset findings corrected before widening multiplication; two reachable postlease failed commit/prompt exits use failstop before unwind. R413 five-file prose enumerates six. Source+copy host spans and nested phase counters do not prove pure PCIe or quiet critical path. All256K, RESTORE, corpus ability and speed/adoption remain pending. R415 registry-missing claim is a lookup error: actual absolute L registry exists and hash is verified here; src/prefill.cpp labels refer to actual src/prefill/prefill.cpp. R416 eight-expert traffic bound applies NT1 decode; a32K prefill route union may need all512 experts and must not be assigned the same bound.')
        dump(F / 'report-registry-v196.json', registry)
        dump(F / 'summary.json', dict(source_pins=build['source_pins'], binary_sha256=actual['binary_sha256'],

            actual_phase_all_ram_pass=True, actual_phase_gpu16384_ram_tail_pass=True,
            requests=actual['requests'], admissions=actual['actual_admissions'], layer_rows=actual['actual_layer_rows'],
            normal_quit=actual['normal_quit'], kernel_checks=actual['kernel_checks'], captures=actual['captures'],
            full32k_paired_rows=[receipts[name] for name in names[-2:]],
            explicit_reserve_mib=700, configured_chunk=8192, context=262144, int8_resident=32768,
            quality_qualified=False, full_physical262144_qualified=False, restore_qualified=False,
            stock_benchmark_executed=False, performance_samples=[], adopted=False,
            next_step='Qualify4K geometry and source+copy span, then unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs3; actual262144 exhausted context remains required before adoption',
            skill_scope=dict(project='/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl', project_only_canonical_revision='97f8b40ca99ec298c24d7ecc7b270e530d43194d',
                user_global_paths_absent=True, experimental_branch_inherits_old_root_skill='Before adoption carry project-only scope relocation; current project discovery targets corrected canonical worktree'),

        for name in names:
            controller = name.replace('-root-', '-').replace('-paired-row-v1', '-paired-row-v1') + '.py'

            if path.is_file():
                dump(F / 'controllers' / (controller + '.json'), dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), text=path.read_text()))
        for language, body in [('ja', '''# decode cache全物理leaseとGPU中間表現の実機検証

decode cacheの全物理extentをprefill中に解放し、終了後にRAMから埋め直して公開する候補を検証した。
2層・2回の小さな実機fixtureと、同一プロセスのfresh GEN1024/32768、通常QUITを完了した。
全RAM配置と先頭GPU16384行＋残りRAM配置を別々に確認。32KではGPU671088640 bytes、RAM671047680 bytesを実際に確保した。
context262144、int8 KV resident32768、8Kチャンク、FP32、明示700 MiB reserve、max_new1、reuseなし。
毎層全512 expertを一度アップロードし、48層・4チャンクを処理した。

静的検査の初回4件は失敗のまま保存。型拡張前の乗算を修正し、到達可能な2つのlease後失敗もfailstopにした。

速度は今回のGEN診断時間から判定しない。次は4K作業領域の検証と、変更しない上流bench.sh --long --runs3。
全物理262144入力、RESTORE、数値能力、正式採用は未成立。新しい4K案とdecode ledgerは別作業ツリーで検証する。
R412は親だけを調査したため、実際の18 source pinsを監査したR413を採否の根拠にする。
R413の「5ファイル」は列挙すると6ファイル。R415の台帳不在は探索誤りで、実際のL台帳をhash検証した。
R416の8 expert転送量上限はNT1 decode対象で、32K prefillのroute集合には適用しない。source+copyと入れ子のphase時間を純PCIe時間やcritical pathとして合計しない。
成功重複ログはmanifestのpath/hash/reasonと構造化証拠に集約し、現controllerが参照する元receiptは変更せず残す。
スキルはこのプロジェクトの.agents/skillsでのみ検出され、ユーザー共通にはない。採用時には親の旧root配置も修正版へ移す。
'''), ('en', '''# Full decode-cache physical lease and GPU residual qualification

A two-layer/two-cycle actual-device fixture and fresh GEN1024/32768 in one process completed with normal QUIT.
All-RAM and GPU16384-prefix/RAM-tail configurations passed separately. The32K hybrid actually allocated671088640 GPU bytes and671047680 RAM bytes.

Individual receipts record GPU pre/post checks, same boot, full SHA checks of12 model inputs, providers, fault-free checks and normal owner closure.
Free/contrib-llvm builds, four CPU/ASan/UBSan configurations, server lifetime and actual-parent static checks passed.
The initial four static findings retain failed status. Multiplication is widened first; two reachable postlease failures now failstop before unwind.

Native GEN diagnostic times do not decide speed. Next:4K workspace qualification and unchanged upstream bench.sh --long --runs3.
Full physical262144 input,RESTORE, capability quality and adoption remain pending. New4K and decode ledger candidates have separate worktrees.
R412 inspected only the parent; R413 audits all18 actual source pins and is the relevant4K audit.
R413 says five but enumerates six files. R415's missing-registry claim is a lookup error; the actual L registry hash is verified here.
R416's eight-expert traffic bound applies to NT1 decode, not a32K prefill route union. Source+copy and nested phase spans are not pure PCIe time or additive critical-path fractions.
A path/hash/reason manifest replaces closed duplicate logs with structured evidence. Immutable receipts stay for current controller consumers.

''')]:
            suffix = '.ja.md' if language == 'ja' else '.md'
            (F / ('README' + suffix)).write_text('<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->\n<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->\n' + body)
        dump(F / 'deletion-manifest.json', dict(serialized=True, active_runs_touched=False,
            original_failed_status_preserved=True, original_pinned_receipts_retained=True, entries=deletions,
            logical_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in deletions), physical_free_space_claim=False))
        dump(F / 'controllers/main-layer-major-phase-publication-v1.py.json', dict(path=__file__, sha256=m.sha(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()))
        files = sorted(str(path.relative_to(W)) for path in F.rglob('*') if path.is_file())
        text = run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        assert 'skipped (' not in text and '== gitleaks: a possible secret' not in text
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        for row in deletions:
            raw = Path(row['path'])
            assert raw.stat().st_size == row['bytes'] and m.sha(raw) == row['sha256']
            assert m.sha(row['replacement']) == row['replacement_sha256']
        for row in deletions:
            Path(row['path']).unlink()
        r.update(deleted_files=len(deletions), deleted_logical_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in deletions))
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', *build['source_pins'], str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'Lease all decode-cache backing for guarded layer-major prefill'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, research_completed=registry['research_completed'])
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'commit', 'deleted_files', 'deleted_logical_bytes')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
